biblical_reference.note: In Hebrew Bible, God's name is written as אֶהֶיְךָ אֶלֹהים אֶחָד  (YHWH), which is often transliterated to 'Adonai' or 'Jehovah' in English, and 'Elohim' in Hebrew. However, in the opening verse of Genesis, the name 'Av' (Father) is used to refer to God.
